title: Admissibility-Preserving Control for Strict-Feedback Nonlinear Systems with Asymmetric Actuator Constraints
summary: This paper develops Admissibility-Preserving Control (APC), a realization-centered safety-critical control framework for strict-feedback systems subject to asymmetric actuator limits, time-varying output constraints, and actuator-rate limitations. APC denotes the overall control architecture, whereas an Admissibility-Preserving Input Realization (APIR) denotes its constraint-realization module. Therein, the APIR dynamically generates the physical plant input while rendering its prescribed asymmetric actuator set forward invariant.
